name: Layered poster
description: A poster built from flat layers that assemble back to front around a large title, then drift apart with the pointer.

props.name: layers
props.description: The layers, each filling the poster. Depth runs from 0, far and still, to 1, nearest. They arrive in depth order and shift with the pointer in proportion to their depth, so draw each a little past the edges.

props.name: title
props.description: The title. Its letters reveal one by one between the layers behind it and the layers in front.

props.name: titleDepth
props.description: Where the title sits in the stack. Layers with a greater depth pass in front of it.

props.name: titleClassName
props.description: Classes for the title: its position, size and colour. It is centred, 19% of the poster's width tall, near the top by default.

props.name: shift
props.description: How far, in pixels, a layer of depth 1 moves with the pointer at the poster's edge.

props.name: replayLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the replay button in the bottom-right corner.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the poster. Give it a size or aspect ratio; it is a size container, so layers can size text in cqw.
